name: Agent Writing Style
description: Opinionated agent writing style. Injects a prose discipline into the system prompt so the model writes like a knowledgeable human, not AI slop. Hard bans on em-dashes and semicolons. Kills the AI vocabulary (delve, tapestry, leverage, pivotal, etc.), copula avoidance (serves as, stands as), 'not just X but Y' parallelisms, superficial -ing tails, sycophancy, signposting, significance inflation, vague attribution, emoji-as-formatting, and mechanical boldface. User-overridable per request.
